title: Clown
text: “I get it. Melromarc… Things are different now than they were back then. I’ll protect everyone.”
“Yes! Well then, Father, now that it’s decided, let’s get going.”
“You’re right. The sooner, the better.”
Just as we were talking, the messenger continued.
“There’s one more piece of unconfirmed information.”
“What?”
“An airplane has been spotted near the Melromarc army.”

I wonder if word has reached them as well? If so, that makes it all the more necessary for us to go. Besides, the fact that Melromarc has an airplane is irrefutable proof of their connection to Shieldfreeden. We must wipe out every last remnant of Takt’s forces. …Anyway, we have no choice but to go.
“All right! Let’s move on to the next phase! Let’s go, everyone!”
Following Father’s command, everyone present let out a battle cry and began moving toward the next operation.
“So you’ve finally shown up. The impostor posing as the Spear Hero, and the Shield Demon King.”

Father, Yuki-chan, the rest of us, and a unit from the Siltvelt Army had been lying in wait on the battlefield for the Melromarc Army. The location was a wilderness with a clear view in Siltvelt, facing the direction of Melromarc. Since a surprise attack here was impossible, Father gave a stern glare and ordered us to engage in battle.
“You lot… have you joined forces with Shieldfreeden to attack Siltvelt?”
Father muttered this question to the Pope standing before him.
“Collaborate? It’s unthinkable that our Three Heroes Church would join forces with such filthy beings as Demi-Humans… This is a holy war, after all.”
“Oink-oink.”
Just then, a Crimson Swine stood next to the Pope and began making some sort of noise. How disgusting. Shall I ignore Father’s protest and just kill it for you?
“What is it saying?”

“‘After all, it seems the Seven Star Heroes were never a match for the Demon of the Shield. I’d arranged things so that if we killed the Spear and the Shield, Papa would approve the engagement, but that good-for-nothing—what a massive letdown,’ she said—such selfish nonsense… Do you even realize what I… what everyone went through because of you?!”
My father declares this to the Crimson Swine with a look of disgust.
“Boo-boo-boo-boo-boo!”
“Don’t mess with me! Do you really get that much pleasure out of watching people suffer?!”
My father continues his conversation with the Crimson Swine.

“This is the Holy War—the moment we can show the world that we are in the right. The day has come for Siltvelt to be defeated in this Holy War and vanish from this world. Eventually, we will exterminate all Demi-Humans, and the world will be elevated to its ideal form!”
“That’s far too self-serving… Everyone is struggling to survive and desperately trying to protect the world from the Waves…”
Eventually, my father fixes the Crimson Swine and the Pope with a very cold stare. Then, from behind, that Trash declared in a loud voice.
“What are you dithering about! Kill the Shield and the Spear quickly! Slaughter every last one of Siltvelt’s Demi-Humans!”

That Trash… I wonder how far he’ll go to get in our way before he’s satisfied. But killing him right here shouldn’t be a problem. The die has already been cast. There’s absolutely no need to worry about the consequences.
“Motoyasu. I thought if we talked, they might understand us a little… but it’s no use. They’re not the kind of people you can reason with.”
Father thrusts his shield forward and assumes a fighting stance. Exactly—there was no way we could reason with these people from the start.
“Ah, that’s right… let me introduce the Hero who’s here to defeat the Shield Demon King.”
“…Hero?”
The Pope said that, and my father-in-law tilted his head in confusion. Then, the crowd of Melromarc soldiers parted… and from within, Itsuki and his party appeared.
“Itsuki…”
“It’s Itsuki, isn’t it?”
“I’d appreciate it if you didn’t go around calling my name so casually.”

Itsuki stares at us with a look of displeasure. What’s with that attitude? Especially coming from Itsuki, who used to work like a slave for my father-in-law. Ah, right—that hadn’t happened in this world yet. He’s been such a minor character that I’d completely forgotten about him.

Anyway, so we’ve got Takt, the remnants of Takt’s forces, the Pope, Trash, and Itsuki—and they’ve all shown up. That’s in order of strength, isn’t it? For some reason, Itsuki—who should be the weakest of the bunch—is acting like some mysterious leader. With this lineup, our victory in this battle is now a foregone conclusion. Though, since I can’t just kill Itsuki outright, I’m a bit stumped on how to deal with him.
“Why is Itsuki here?!”
“Why? Isn’t it obvious? I came here specifically to punish you lot for using the Hero’s power to commit evil deeds.”
“Huh? But… I thought Itsuki was over at Melromarc, preparing for the wave…”
My father looked at me, then turned his face toward the Siltvelt army.

“Yes, but the leaders of Shieldfreeden came all the way here by plane to ask for my help personally. ‘We want you to avenge Lord Takt, who was killed after falling into a despicable trap,’ they said… I listened to their story and heard all about your misdeeds.”
“Itsuki! Listen to us—we were set up by Takt, and we just fought back! The real culprits are… Shieldfreeden and Takt’s remnants… and those Melromarc people over there!”
But Itsuki shook his head, as if he wouldn’t listen to a word we had to say.

“It’s true that some aspects of the Three Heroes Church’s religious ideology are hard to understand, but they’re on our side now. And… my eyes, my ears… my intuition—all of them are telling me that you’re the ones at fault. Are these people the villains? Did you really think I’d accept such a despicable story…? I’ve lost comrades to the assassins you sent!”
“It’s the truth! Please listen to us! We never sent any assassins in the first place!”
“I can’t believe that. For the sake of the justice I believe in—Naofumi, Motoyasu!—I’ll defeat you both! And then, let’s report our victory to those in Shieldfreeden who are waiting for us to win!”
“…Itsuki! Are you saying you agree with exterminating all Demi-Humans!?”
“Of course I don’t really mean that—it’s just an act. Everyone has a position they have to maintain.”
“What do you mean, ‘position’? Don’t be ridiculous!”
“We have no reason to be criticized by you lot, who keep committing evil deeds!”

It seems he genuinely believes that the Crimson Swine and the fanatics of the Three Heroes Church are acting out of goodwill. What a clown. It’s just like looking at my past self. Haha, he doesn’t seem to realize at all that he’s being treated as a pawn. Well, for me, acting as Father’s pawn is the ultimate joy.
“I’ll show you that evil must be defeated without exception! Mald, Logir, everyone—please teach them a lesson!”
Itsuki and his companions each grab their weapons and prepare for battle. What a hassle… If I use a powerful move carelessly, I might end up killing Itsuki. If I do that, we’ll end up in a loop.
“Itsuki, do you really want to fight this badly?!”
“I don’t believe your lies! I’ll avenge my comrades right here!”
“I see… but I’ll keep saying I didn’t do it, no matter how many times it takes. Because that’s the truth.”
“Hmph. You’re a coward, yet you’re playing the victim?”
“A victim? No. I was a victim. That’s the past tense. If Itsuki—if the world—is going to slaughter all my comrades, then I’ll fight to protect everyone. I’m… a party to this now.”
My father declares this with a determined expression. Those words resonate deeply within Motoyasu’s heart. If my father says he’ll protect everyone, then I’ll annihilate every enemy that attacks us.
“Itsuki, it seems you want to kill us, but we’ll absolutely never kill you. To protect the world—and to make sure this world isn’t wasted—we can’t have you dying.”
“What kind of nonsense are you spouting?!”
“I’m not saying this because I want you to understand. I’m saying it because I have to!”

That’s right—we cannot kill Itsuki. If we kill him, everything that has happened up to today will be for nothing. Even if we had considered the possibility of a loop, that would only be a measure to take if the loop actually occurred. Just as I was thinking this, Itsuki addressed his comrades.
“Come on! In the name of justice, let’s put an end to evil!”
And from far behind us… a group flying the Melromarc army’s banner is charging toward us.
“Damn… are there still that many of them!?”
“Oh! It seems the people of Melromarc have gathered all at once and rushed to lend us their strength! Everyone! What are you waiting for? Let’s start the battle!”

At Trash’s declaration, the Melromarc soldiers let out a battle cry and charged toward us. The Siltvelt soldiers responded to the challenge. Right now, on the battlefield, we heroes and the Pope are facing off against each other.
The battle has… begun.
